verdict.rationale: A/B testing is a fair question for an email marketing platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents A/B or split testing of subject lines or content, or automatic winner selection based on engagement. The nearest items are subject-line personalization with merge fields and engagement reporting (link clicks, peak engagement times), and these are different features.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement
